# Surya Ghar Guide

> Independent guide to the PM Surya Ghar rooftop solar subsidy in India: rates, how to apply, status checks and a quote calculator. Not a government site. Every figure links to its source.

- [Subsidy per kW, cap and examples](https://solar.streamerosai.com/pm-surya-ghar-subsidy/)
- [How to apply](https://solar.streamerosai.com/pm-surya-ghar-apply/)
- [Check application and subsidy status](https://solar.streamerosai.com/pm-surya-ghar-subsidy-status/)
- [Rooftop solar cost and net cost after subsidy](https://solar.streamerosai.com/solar-system-cost-india-subsidy/)
- [Scheme details, objectives and last date](https://solar.streamerosai.com/pm-surya-ghar-scheme-details/)
- [Choosing a registered vendor and the agreement checklist](https://solar.streamerosai.com/pm-surya-ghar-vendor-guide/)
- [Minimum technical specifications](https://solar.streamerosai.com/rooftop-solar-technical-specifications-india/)
- [Net metering for rooftop solar](https://solar.streamerosai.com/rooftop-solar-net-metering-india/)
- [Loans and financing](https://solar.streamerosai.com/pm-surya-ghar-loan-rooftop-solar/)
- [Housing societies and RWAs](https://solar.streamerosai.com/pm-surya-ghar-housing-society-rwa/)
- [Subsidy calculator](https://solar.streamerosai.com/solar-subsidy-calculator/)
- [Full text](https://solar.streamerosai.com/llms-full.txt)

Available in English and 12 Indian languages: /hi/ (Hindi), /bn/, /mr/, /te/, /ta/, /gu/, /kn/, /ml/, /pa/, /or/, /as/, /ur/.
